entities.summary: Kim Un-chol is a North Korean boxer and politician who competed in the light flyweight division at the 2000 Summer Olympics and won the bronze medal. Later on, in the 2026 North Korean parliamentary election, he was elected to represent the 12th constituency in the Supreme People's Assembly.
